verdict.rationale: A probe got HTTP 200 at https://docs.x.ai/openapi.json, and the response contains an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly downloadable from xAI's docs domain. llms.txt is also served as a supplementary machine-readable index. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the spec (its coverage of all endpoints, versioning, update cadence), independent or hands-on corroboration that the spec is complete and usable for code generation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.x.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
